KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. mitoto

3. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

4. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Anga.

5. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

6. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.

7. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. pana

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain uliopita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Lishe Bora and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma: Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain thi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hili na Haya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
